page.notes: Reading of the notes and of the italic type is approximate because the scan is blurred. The Greek in the right margin (Γνῶσις re- gît πεῖραν ἢ λόγον) is hard to read and should be checked. The Greek words in the text (φαινόμενα, κεκρυμμένα, γνῶσις, πεῖραν) are read from the scan, and their accents are not fully certain. The italic/roman boundaries in the Quicquid and Syllogismus sentences are uncertain. The last word of the text, "Gale", is cut at the line end; the catchword "nus" completes it. The printed hyphen in "dividun-tur", "con-nexionis" and "syllogis-mo" is joined in the text. The last line "Galenus" is a catchword continuation and is not part of the text. The bottom right "nus" is the catchword and is not repeated in the text.
